enrichment.headline: Approves up to $2M for Sysco to supply food for student meals, without public bidding, through Dec. 2021
enrichment.summary: The district would buy supplemental food and supplies, including meat, poultry, high-protein foods and fresh produce, from Sysco San Francisco for the student meal program. The contract runs August 12 through December 31, 2021. The district is skipping public bidding under a legal exception to public bidding (called the Graydon exception).

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Graydon Exception to Public Bidding and Nutrition Services Food Contract - Sysco San Francisco, Inc. - Chief Systems and Services Officer

enrichment.headline: Approves the district's summary of how it will spend Education Protection Account funds in 2021-22
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution summarizing planned spending of the Education Protection Account (state Proposition 30 funds) for fiscal year 2021-22. The text gives no dollar amounts.

items.title: Education Protection Act - Proposition 30 Funds - Fiscal Year 2021-2022

enrichment.headline: Lets the district borrow temporarily between its own funds in 2021-22 to cover cash-flow needs
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution allowing the district to borrow between its own funds during fiscal year 2021-22 when needed for cash-flow purposes. It also authorizes repaying the borrowed funds, as Education Code Section 42603 allows. No amount is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Temporary Borrowing Between District Funds - Fiscal Year 2021-2022

enrichment.headline: Approves the district's 2021-22 funding application to the state through the CARS system
enrichment.summary: The Board approves the district's 2021-22 application for funding through the Consolidated Application and Reporting System (CARS). It also authorizes the Superintendent, or a designee, to submit the application to the California Department of Education. No dollar amount is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Consolidated Application and Reporting System (CARS) - Application for Funding - Fiscal Year 2021-2022 - Chief Business Officer

enrichment.headline: Asks Alameda County to set the property tax rate for bonds the district expects to sell in 2021-22
enrichment.summary: The Board asks the Alameda County Board of Supervisors to set the tax rate for district bonds expected to be sold during fiscal year 2021-22. It also authorizes the actions needed to carry that out. No dollar amount is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Consolidated Engineering Labs up to $36,367 for testing and inspection on Lincoln Elementary repairs
enrichment.summary: Consolidated Engineering Laboratories will provide materials testing and construction inspection for the Lincoln Elementary School water intrusion repairs. The basic services cost $26,367, and the district adds $10,000 for extra services if needed. Work began June 16, 2021, before this approval, and is scheduled to last until August 23, 2021, though it may run later if delays occur.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.sourceIssue: The text calls the $10,000 contingency a 10% fee, but 10% of the $26,367.00 base amount would be about $2,637; the contract sets the contingency at a flat $10,000, and the stated $36,367.00 total is correct.
items.title: Agreement for Materials Testing Services – Consolidated Engineering Laboratories – Lincoln Elementary School Water Intrusion Repairs Project

enrichment.headline: Renews Brandman University partnership for teacher and school-staff interns through June 2024
enrichment.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Brandman University covers intern partnerships and practicum placements for K-12 teaching, special education, school counseling, school psychology and administrative credentials. It runs July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2024. The text states no dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding and Interagency Agreement - District and Brandman University - Intern Partnership and Practica Programs - K-12 Teaching - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Lets the district share student data at no cost with four education groups to support reading progress
enrichment.summary: The district may share student-level data with The Oakland Public Education Fund, The Oakland REACH, CARES for Learning and The New Teacher Project (TNTP). The groups would use it to track reading growth and school engagement and to keep families informed. The agreement covers April 21, 2021 through June 30, 2022, began before this approval, and costs the district nothing.

enrichment.summary: School Facility Consultants of Sacramento will help the district find and apply for state funding for new school construction, modernization and joint-use projects. enrichment.headline: Awards Data Media Services $62,000 to install 25 security cameras at three school sites
enrichment.summary: Data Media Services, the lowest responsive bidder, will install 25 exterior cameras and set up the servers and software for the video surveillance project. outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
